paragraphs: Social media platforms are being flooded with ultra-realistic ads created by AI to sell products that either don’t exist or turn out to be cheap junk.

Scammers use AI because it allows them to generate professional-looking videos and fake customer testimonials quickly and cheaply without real photoshoots. These ads appear on both shady websites and legitimate platforms like Amazon. Clicking these dangerous links can instantly download malware onto a user’s machine or expose them to phishing attacks, which can lead to repeated unauthorized credit card transactions and data theft.

Experts note that these ads easily slip through automated moderation systems due to the sheer volume of new content. To stay safe, users should always do a reverse image search, carefully verify unfamiliar website URLs, look out for strange bot-like comments, and remain deeply cautious of suspicious celebrity endorsements or any online offers that look too perfect to be true.

paragraphs: Scammers are now using AI to make very realistic fake ads on social media. They show beautiful pictures of things like coffee mugs or toys, but these products are not real.

When people click the links to buy them, they can end up on dangerous websites. These websites can secretly steal private credit card information or install bad programs on computers. Scammers make money quickly and then disappear. These fake ads are even on big websites like Amazon because computers cannot catch them all.

To protect yourself, you should never trust prices that are too low. You can check the pictures on the internet first, look at the website address carefully, and read the comments to see if they look real.

paragraphs: There are many new fake ads on social media today. Scammers use AI to make beautiful videos of things which do not exist.

When you click the link to buy a toy or a cup, you can lose your money. Sometimes, these bad websites take your credit card numbers or break your computer. It is very easy and cheap for scammers to make these ads. They can put them on big web shops too, for example, Amazon.
If a price is too low, it is usually a trick. You must be careful. Always check the name of the website before you give it your money.
